entries.name: mapOption
entries.scope: Map one present payload to a new Maybe; absent input skips transform; Some(null) stays present.

entries.name: filterOption
entries.scope: Retain the same present container when an int predicate accepts its payload; absent or rejected input yields absence.

entries.name: orElse
entries.scope: Return the existing payload record or an already evaluated fallback record; result is not a Maybe.

entries.name: orElseGet
entries.scope: Return the payload record; invoke a nullary fallback only when absent.

entries.name: orElseOption
entries.scope: Return the original present Maybe, or call the nullary fallback once and return its Maybe unchanged.

entries.name: foldOption
entries.scope: Invoke exactly one branch, a nullary absent branch or unary payload branch; return its typed result record.

entries.name: flattenOption
entries.scope: Flatten one Maybe-of-Maybe level, retaining the nested container identity; absent outer input skips payload access.

entries.name: mapResult
entries.scope: Map only success payload into a fresh ok result; retain the existing error container without invoking transform.

entries.name: mapErr
entries.scope: Map only error payload into a fresh err result; retain the existing success container without invoking transform.

entries.name: orElseResult
entries.scope: Invoke one error-to-Result continuation only on err; return its Result without nesting; success identity retained.

entries.name: foldResult
entries.scope: Invoke exactly one unary branch with the corresponding typed payload; return its result record.

entries.name: attempt
entries.scope: Invoke through existing FxTry; return ok(result record) or err(typed reference record to full original FxOutcome); kernel/admission failures propagate.

entries.name: tap
entries.scope: Call one effect with the actual typed payload and return the exact original value record; no deep copying or swallowing failure.

entries.name: findField
entries.scope: Maybe of the selected physical field record; required zero-based occurrence counts equal ready names only; no payload evaluation.

entries.name: hasField
entries.scope: Whether that physical named occurrence exists; named uninitialized payloads count as present; no payload evaluation.

entries.name: getField
entries.scope: Return the existing selected field record; missing or negative occurrence raises FxIndex; no payload evaluation.

entries.name: assoc
entries.scope: First matching row as Maybe; keyIndex=1 covers reverse association with the same search; empty rows skipped.

entries.name: pairlis
entries.scope: Fresh forward-ordered key/value rows then shallow tail rows; equal lengths required.

entries.name: getProperty
entries.scope: Maybe of the first matching flat property value; present zero/null differs from absent.

entries.name: setProperty
entries.scope: Update first matching value, otherwise append a key/value pair; return same target Array.

entries.name: removeProperty
entries.scope: Remove first matching key/value pair; return int 1 if found, otherwise 0.

entries.name: getProperties
entries.scope: First property whose key matches any indicator; Maybe of key/value/index; Array index is explicit, not a Lisp cons tail.

entries.name: asOperand
entries.scope: Construct one ordinary OPERANDS_TEMPLATE-compatible prepared operand; present left then right actuals, exact source R/void and named failures. No new syntax mode.

entries.name: mismatch
entries.scope: Maybe of first differing index, or shared-prefix length when only lengths differ; no difference yields none.

entries.name: searchSequence
entries.scope: Maybe of first full subsequence start at or after start; empty pattern matches start; explicit equality.

entries.name: substitute
entries.scope: Fresh same-profile Array, replacing every equivalent element; source unchanged and referenced targets shared.

entries.name: indexOf
entries.scope: First literal byte-substring index at or after clamped start; -1 absent. Empty part matches the chosen valid boundary.

entries.name: lastIndexOf
entries.scope: Last literal byte-substring index at or before clamped start; overlapping candidates are tested, -1 absent.

entries.name: compareText
entries.scope: Unsigned-octet lexicographic order -1/0/1; exact case-sensitive content, length breaks an equal-prefix tie.

entries.name: trim
entries.scope: Fresh byte slice after removing any chosen boundary characters on both sides; default is six ASCII whitespace characters.

entries.name: trimStart
entries.scope: The same shared trim algorithm at the start only.

entries.name: trimEnd
entries.scope: The same shared trim algorithm at the end only.

entries.name: repeatText
entries.scope: Fresh repeated char[] through the shared generic cycle algorithm; negative count is SequenceSize.

entries.name: padLeft
entries.scope: Fresh byte string of at least width units; repeat then truncate fill at the left, preserve text when already long enough.

entries.name: padRight
entries.scope: The same shared padding algorithm with padding on the right.

entries.name: translate
entries.scope: Simultaneous literal byte substitution, equal-size alphabets, first duplicate source entry wins, unknown bytes retained.

entries.name: join
entries.scope: Join already rendered char[] parts through shared intercalate; no hidden printer or implicit coercion.

entries.name: formatInt
entries.scope: Exact signed bigint to lowercase digits in radix 2..36; shared with the internal nonnegative decimal name builder.

entries.name: parseInt
entries.scope: Strict whole-input signed bigint parse in radix 2..36; optional sign, ASCII digits case-insensitive, no whitespace/prefix/trailing text.

entries.name: removePrefix
entries.scope: Remove one exact leading affix when present; fresh slice either way.

entries.name: removeSuffix
entries.scope: The same affix-removal algorithm at the end.

entries.name: sum
entries.scope: Common (+ initial copy(items)) Expression over actual ready numeric fields; empty input returns the initial value record.

entries.name: product
entries.scope: Common (* initial copy(items)) Expression over actual ready numeric fields; empty input returns the initial value record.

entries.name: minimum
entries.scope: First least ordered numeric value as its original typed record; empty input raises SequenceSize.

entries.name: maximum
entries.scope: First greatest ordered numeric value as its original typed record; empty input raises SequenceSize.

entries.name: argMin
entries.scope: Zero-based first index of the least ordered numeric value, using the same extremum loop.

entries.name: argMax
entries.scope: Zero-based first index of the greatest ordered numeric value, using the same extremum loop.

entries.name: extrema
entries.scope: Pair of original minimum and maximum records; delegates to the two existing extremum directions.

entries.name: min
entries.scope: Choose the lesser of two typed ordered numeric value records; first identity wins ties.

entries.name: max
entries.scope: Choose the greater of two typed ordered numeric value records; first identity wins ties.

entries.name: minMax
entries.scope: Both original records in nondecreasing order; ties preserve input order and both identities.

entries.name: clamp
entries.scope: Closed ordered interval through shared min/max; reversed bounds raise NumericDomain.

entries.name: sign
entries.scope: Int -1/0/1 for ordered numeric values; no IEEE NaN or complex sign contract is claimed.

entries.name: gcd
entries.scope: Exact nonnegative bigint Euclidean GCD, including gcd(0;0)=0.

entries.name: lcm
entries.scope: Exact nonnegative bigint LCM through gcd; any zero input yields zero.

entries.name: divMod
entries.scope: Exact bigint floor quotient and remainder with divisor sign; zero divisor raises NumericDomain.
